title: ocp row
description: Private input contract v1 (docs/architecture/08_PRIVATE_ADAPTER_INTERFACE.md §10). One row as the adapter emits it. An optional field may be absent or null (the same thing); the empty string is invalid everywhere. Raw firm values go in x_* keys; _src is the row's location in the report, without sheet names.

amount.description: a finite JSON number or a decimal string; no NaN, exponents in strings, separators or commas

ccy.description: a currency code; the backend upper-cases it and reads RUR as RUB
